process: Portrait generation references from Flow batches 1 and 2, then deterministic native pixel assembly and sequential edits. No independently regenerated cutscene frames.

steps.edit: Remove connected exact-cream background, mirror to face right, fit once to 144 logical pixels high, enlarge 3x.
Raise far eyebrow one logical pixel using its dark pixels; tip head one pixel back/up, keep all torso/mug/leg pixels.
Return head to level using original head patch; retain quiet smile and lift two corner pixels. Body stays fixed.
Remove connected cream background, fit once to same 144 logical pixel height, face left.
Move isolated arm pixel patches outward 2 and up 5 logical pixels, face and chart protected.
Lift left shoe/foot patch four logical pixels in place.
Return raised shoe, bend knee patch one logical pixel. Clipboard face/chart never changes.
